title: Other reports keep their own export error message
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Before the release was installed, you noted the message Sales By Customer shows when its CSV export fails because the computer is offline.
  • You can switch this computer's network connection off and on (for example Wi-Fi).
  • Starting screen: the release is installed; Sales By Customer (Reports, then "Sales By Customer" under PERFORMANCE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Switch the network connection off.
  2. Choose "Download (CSV)" from the ⋯ menu.
  3. Read the message.
  4. Switch the network connection back on.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the computer is offline.
  • Step 2: the export fails.
  • Step 3: the same message as before the release; not "We couldn't export this report. Please try again.", which is for the six aging reports only.
  • Step 4: the connection is back.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV)

  • Story 3, Error Handling: “If an export fails for any other reason (a server error or a lost connection), nothing downloads and one error message shows: "We couldn't export this report. Please try again." This message is on these six reports only; the other reports keep theirs.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Export fails for any other reason | "We couldn't export this report. Please try again." | Error toast; nothing downloads; these six reports only”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 2 "Export" (board Export.dc.html). The design draws no picture of this behaviour (all 7 boards and 45 figures checked); the case follows the PRD.

AUTOMATION: HOLD - needs records and screenshots captured before the release is installed on the test site
